description.value: Beethoven's Pizza is a well-established pizzeria located on the Columbia Valley Highway at Cultus Lake, a popular recreational destination just outside Chilliwack. The restaurant has been serving the area for over 44 years, offering dine-in and takeout pizza with a wide menu that includes vegetarian and gluten-free options. Its proximity to Cultus Lake Waterpark and the surrounding valley makes it a natural stop for cyclists riding through the Fraser Valley.

address.value: 4125 Columbia Valley Hwy, Cultus Lake, BC V2R 5B6
